caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light, beige background. At the top, there is a chain with a hook at the upper end, consisting of three linked chains that join at a central point and then extend outwards and downwards to connect to the ends and center of a horizontal bar. Hanging from the bar are six identical, vertically-oriented weights with rounded tops, each attached to the bar by a small hook. Below this assembly, there is a diagram of a wheel with eight evenly spaced spokes radiating from a central hub, with circular nodes at the outer end of each spoke, forming a ring. The wheel is accompanied by a measuring scale marked in feet and inches at the bottom center of the drawing. The artist's signature, "Mildred Lord," is present in the lower right corner. All lines and objects are rendered in fine, consistent grey pencil.
title: Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
